PLAN 02 | THE FIRST COMMAND WORKS

DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9

CHARACTER REFERENCES

{{CHAR_JAMSHID_WORKER}} @Jamshid (look 5)   {{CHAR_DOCK_WORKERS}} @Chinese People (look 1) @Chinese People (look 2) 

LOCATION REFERENCES

{{LOC_WORKING_QUAY}} @Port Shipyard Hall (look 1) 

PROP REFERENCES

{{PROP_CARGO_HOIST}}  {{PROP_MOORING_ROPE}}

DIRECTION AND CONTINUITY

Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence. Preserve each referenced identity, costume, proportions and rigid handmade mask; mask geometry and eye openings remain fixed. All visible humans wear their referenced masks. Emotion comes from posture, hands, breath and visible eyes. Each listed hard cut changes the physical camera station, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement follows a possible path and recovers focus on essential action. References anchor design; written lighting controls illumination. Tactile modern Iranian mythological design, analog realism and natural imperfections. NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

LOCATION AND LIGHT

Cold neutral overcast daylight with water bounce. Preserve the referenced hoist, crate, bollards and level loading area. Light stays constant during the command; authority comes from posture and camera organization.

START STATE AND BLOCKING

Geography: NORTH is the water and suspended cargo loading zone; SOUTH is the dry quay. Jamshid starts SOUTH of the workers facing NORTH toward the load. Worker A operates the brake at west; B handles a hauling line east; C controls the guide rope south of the load. Nobody stands beneath the crate. Workers pull out of sequence, causing a low sideways swing. Jamshid must watch this in front of him, never behind him.


PLAN 02 | SHOTS

SHOT 02-01 | 0s–3s | 3 SECONDS

28mm handheld from SOUTH behind Jamshid, his back foreground left. Workers and suspended crate fill the middle distance ahead of him. A struggles with the brake as B pulls too early and C loses guide-rope tension. Camera reacts to their opposing movement; the crate swings a short distance over the clear loading zone.

SHOT 02-02 | 3s–5s | 2 SECONDS

50mm lateral close from WEST beside the brake. A's grip slips, the line jerks and C strains in the background. Camera flinches with the line but recovers focus immediately. Their inability to coordinate is readable.

SHOT 02-03 | 5s–8s | 3 SECONDS

35mm from the SOUTHWEST, moving with Jamshid as he steps into the workers' safe operating aisle. His back and left profile face camera; he looks north at the workers. He raises his RIGHT palm to shoulder height, elbow bent, fingers together, ordering them to stop, then reaches toward A's brake hand to steady it.

SHOT 02-04 | 8s–11s | 3 SECONDS

40mm front three-quarter from NORTHWEST of Jamshid, looking SOUTH across dry quay only. The suspended cargo is NORTH of Jamshid, behind the camera and entirely OUT OF FRAME. He looks toward B just beside lens, points sharply to the hauling line and signals a controlled pull; then turns his eyes west to A and presses his palm downward to hold the brake. No speech.

SHOT 02-05 | 11s–15s | 4 SECONDS

28mm side-wide from WEST showing all three stations and Jamshid between them, outside the load path. He redirects C's guide rope, watches B pull, then cues A to release slowly. Their successive responses steady the crate and begin its final controlled descent. Camera shifts physically toward the coordinated group, no zoom.

END STATE AND EDIT

The crate has stopped swinging and is descending through its last few centimeters. Jamshid remains engaged with the workers, right hand controlling the final lowering. The next block completes the landing.

SOUND

Conflicting rope strains, pulley chatter, effortful breaths, hurried feet, then a steadier brake and rope rhythm. No intelligible shouted orders.

NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

END PROMPT
